A_analytic.refinement: every error at L2 is smaller than at L0 (no strict monotonicity)

B_functional_equivalence.metric: max|F_functional - F_wrapper| / max(1, max|F_wrapper|) over states/times

agreement_at_L2.near_zero_group: a group whose DA norm is < 1e-8 x the full gradient norm is judged by ||dg_group|| / ||g_full|| <= 1e-6 instead

section10_production_adequacy.definition: FSA gradient at the production tolerance L0 vs the refined FSA gradient at L2

D_state_consistency.metric: max over (t, b, i) of |x - x_ref| / train_range_i, x_ref = state-only solve at rtol/atol = 1e-12/1e-14 (float64)

E_independence.structural: d F_b / d x_c == 0 exactly for every b != c (float64 jacrev)
E_independence.stage1_temperature: perturbing T_obs of trajectory c leaves F_b bit-identical

vs_float64_reference.reference: float64 FSA gradient at L2 on the same batch

G_finite_differences.stable_region: two consecutive h whose estimates differ by <= 1e-4 relative
G_finite_differences.pass: stable estimate within 1e-3 relative of the FSA L2 gradient
